data.name: Bigfoot vs Scots
data.detailed_description:
Dark Scottish Humor Meets Monkey Island Welcome to Amadan, a rugged, remote Scottish island serving as a hideaway for the world’s most eccentric myths and monsters. Bigfoot vs Scots is a 3D third-person open-world dark comedy that pits Scotland’s quirkiest residents against an unexpected threat: Bigfoot himself.

You play as Ann, a sharp-witted and fiery outcast who has returned to the island after being banished as a child. Armed with a legendary family sword and a wicked tongue, Ann must uncover her family's dark secrets while navigating a hostile community that greets her with suspicion and mockery. To survive, you must fight for your place in a world that treats you like a monster.

WELCOME TO THE ISLAND OF AMADAN Forget bloated hack-and-slash hitboxes; survival on Amadan requires mastering "Cultural Duels" and systemic absurdity. The humor here is harsh, unapologetic, and strictly +18.

  • Systemic Absurdity: Every action has unhinged consequences. Feed a haggis whiskey between midnight and daybreak? Congratulations, you’ve just triggered a "Wearhaggis" boss fight.

  • Bizarre Factions: Navigate a truly chaotic ecosystem. Cross paths with Kenny the Functional Drunk Haggis, survive the Rusty Badger Pub's notorious drinking challenges, avoid a coven of useless Norwegian vampires, and deal with the "Mad Biker" werewolf pack.

  • Hyper-Realistic Heritage: The absurdity plays out in a stunning, high-fidelity Unreal Engine 5 world. We’ve utilized institutionally backed photogrammetry to 3D-scan real ancient Pictish stones and gravestones, injecting authentic Scottish history directly into the environment.

THE SOUL BENEATH THE CHAOS: 7 YEARS OF GRIT Bigfoot vs Scots is the brainchild of a solo developer, and beneath the brutal banter and cryptid chaos, the narrative mirrors her own real-life experience.

Given up for adoption at birth and navigating life as a neurodivergent, Kitty knows exactly what it feels like to be an outsider searching for acceptance. Just as Ann fights to carve out her place on Amadan, Kitty poured a lifetime of navigating identity and marginalization into the game's lore. while still pushing that Edgy Scottish Humour that does not hold back. 

Built over seven grueling, uninterrupted years of unpaid solo development, this game is a defiant triumph. It’s a story about finding belonging, embracing the quirks of newfound relationships, and proving that when the world treats you like a monster, you grab a sword, plant your feet, and fight back.
